description: Built on the input-otp library. Renders a segmented input for one-time password or verification code entry. Each slot is visually distinct but backed by a single native input element.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to/from the OTP input
Fills the current slot and advances to the next
Deletes the value in the current slot and moves to the previous
Moves the caret to the previous slot
Moves the caret to the next slot
Pastes a full code across all slots

focus.notes: Focus ring appears on the currently active slot. The underlying input receives focus; slot highlight is managed visually by the library.

announcements: The input is announced with its accessible label and current value
Slot position context is conveyed via the library's internal handling

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for slot values and placeholder indicators)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for slot borders, separators, and focus rings)

consumerResponsibilities: Always provide an accessible label via aria-label or an associated <label> element
Communicate the expected code length to the user (e.g. "Enter the 6-digit code")
Provide clear error messaging when the entered code is invalid
